chunks: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام was asked about the minimum amount for which the thief is to be cut off.
He said: "A quarter of a dinar."

key_terms.دِينَارٍ: a dinar, a gold coin used as a measure of value
key_terms.يُقْطَعُ: the prescribed cutting off in the legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount for which a thief's hand is cut off in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum threshold at which the legal punishment for theft applies. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام answers concisely that the amount is a quarter of a dinar.
